paper_title: Space-Efficient Language Generation in the Limit
authors: Nicolas Flammarion, Chirag Pabbaraju, Hristo Papazov, Miltiadis Stouras, Ola Svensson
statement: Several directions remain open, including extending the framework to non-uniform learners, and developing analogous tradeoffs for other resources such as time and sample complexities.
context: 5. Conclusion This paper develops a space-efficient model of generation in the limit for the DFA family Cs,k and proves a tight memory–breadth tradeoff: poly(s, k) space guarantees hallucination-free generation up to an exponential gap, while achieving substantially smaller gaps (and, in particular, exact identification) forces exponential memory. Several directions remain open, including extending the framework to non-uniform learners, and developing analogous tradeoffs for other resources such as time and sample complexities. 13 F LAMMARION PABBARAJU PAPAZOV S TOURAS S VENSSON
